decision_summary: Proceed with QIF v0.6.8 Context Memory Boundary.
rationale: Current agent runtimes use sessions, local context, memory, and compaction. QIF needs explicit context/memory evidence so old or contaminated context does not silently justify tool actions.
recommendation: Release v0.6.8 after npm test and repository hygiene checks pass.
target_audience: QIF maintainers and AI agents using Action Quality Contract
expected_user_reaction: They can see which memory/context influenced an action and whether it was fresh and contamination-checked.
artifact_change_recommendations: Add contextMemoryBoundaries and contextMemoryEvidence to action-quality-contract schema, example, verifier, fixtures, docs, and release notes.
organization_change_recommendations: Keep verifier boundary explicit: context memory evidence does not prove remembered facts are semantically correct.
